name: polybasic
description: A friendly BASIC for making games in the browser, compiled to JavaScript.
author: akadjoker

scripts.build: esbuild src/browser.js --bundle --format=esm --legal-comments=inline --outfile=dist/polybasic.js && esbuild src/engine/physics/rapier/rapier-backend.js --bundle --format=esm --legal-comments=inline --banner:js="/* PolyBasic physics: Rapier (https://rapier.rs, Apache-2.0, Copyright 2020 Dimforge EURL) bundled by esbuild - generated by npm run build, do not edit. Licences: see LICENSE-THIRD-PARTY */" --outfile=dist/physics.js
scripts.build:vendor: esbuild web/vendor-src/codemirror.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --legal-comments=eof --banner:js="/* CodeMirror 6 (MIT, https://codemirror.net) bundled by esbuild - generated by npm run build:vendor, do not edit. Licences: see LICENSE-THIRD-PARTY */" --outfile=web/vendor/codemirror.js
